text: The loom has answered your thought.
The answer you seek has been written into the next prescript.
Do not explain it yet. Let the silence finish weaving.
The third thought is not the answer. It is bait.
You already know what to do. You only deny the cost.
Wait until the noise becomes regular.
Eat noodles. Do not ask why.
Rice, with something salty. Your system needs stability.
Fried food is allowed. Do not mistake it for an answer.
Soup. This is not a day for dry decisions.
